paper: RL OF THOUGHTS: NAVIGATING LLM REASONING (ICLR 2026)

training.algorithm: offline Double-Dueling-DQN with target network and Huber loss
training.reward: final correctness +/-1 + process-potential delta - action cost
training.prm_note: Local traces do not contain Math-Shepherd PRM scores; deterministic trace evidence is used as a process-reward proxy.

holdout.warning: Offline action agreement and proxy return are not end-to-end answer accuracy.
